data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 淋浴间瓷砖上的湿润贴合
data.description: 游泳馆闭馆后的淋浴室里，温水从莲蓬头倾泻而下。湿透的连体泳装被拉扯开来，白羽双手撑在湿滑的瓷砖墙壁上，弓着后背在一次次撞击中彻底瘫软。
data.location: steamy tiled communal shower room after hours with water echoing on floor
data.action: leaning with palms flat against gleaming wet ceramic wall, wet swimsuit pulled aside, back arched in trembling helpless ecstasy as warm water streams over her
data.lighting: dim waterproof overhead lamp creating glistening water trails on smooth porcelain skin
data.mood: steamy wet abandon, echoing aquatic ecstasy, sheer physical exhaustion from bliss
data.promptProse: Resting hands on wet shower tiles, Shiroha arches her back with pulled-aside swimsuit as hot water cascades over her trembling flushed curves.
data.animaCaption: Shiroha supported against shower tiles as cascading water warms her trembling curves.
